sources: Esri World_Imagery around the cpwshop site points
summary: Independent re-read of cpwshop (all 7 Anthracite site pages, 06/16/2027) and CPW's Paonia pages confirms every stored field: 7 drive-in Electric sites 017-023, 'Electricity Hookup: 50' at all 7, $36.00/night ($252/week), all Back-In on gravel, Maximum Vehicle Length 017 22, 018 25, 019 27, 020 60, 021 60, 022 70, 023 60; no water ('water is not available'), vault toilets; reservation required on cpwshop up to six months ahead, 14 days in 28; 'Paonia is closed from October 1 to May 1 each year.' Creekside confirmed on imagery. No changes.
flags: Waterfront creekside confirmed (no change): on Esri imagery the stream channel along the loop's south edge is ~10-15 m wide (well under the ~30 m river size), and sites 020 (38.94000,-107.35909) and 021 (38.94003,-107.35891) sit ~5-15 m from its north bank, 022 ~15-20 m, across a thin strip of grass, gravel and scattered willow with no continuous screen. That channel joins a wider braided channel ~150 m west. cpwshop tags 020, 021 and 022 'Proximity to Water: Riverfront' (the size rule makes it creekside).
Pin 38.94016,-107.35891 is the centroid of the 7 cpwshop site points (all within ~40 m of it). OK.
Minor conflict: cpwshop's site pages say 'Check In Time: 2:00 pm'; CPW's Paonia camping page says 'check-in time is 1 p.m.'. Neither is stored.

Phone 970-921-5721 confirmed (CPW Paonia park page). Status: CPW's only closure notice is 'Paonia State Park Boat Ramp is CLOSED' (hand launch allowed); the campground is in its ordinary Oct 1 - May 1 winter closure.
Length: 017 is listed 22 ft (driveway 25); 018-023 take 25-70 ft, so 6 of 7 sites fit a 23-ft rig.
